response: No, severe macrosomia is typically not manifested at 11-14 weeks of gestation. Macrosomia, which refers to a birth weight of 4000g or more, is usually diagnosed later in pregnancy, often after 28 weeks of gestation, when fetal growth patterns and estimated fetal weights can be more accurately assessed through ultrasound. At 11-14 weeks, it is still early to predict or diagnose macrosomia.
